Name: Phoenix Farm - A Standard Map Variant (CP and MTN)
Author: AuroraPhoenix44
Description:
[b][size=6][center]Information[/center][/size]
[/b]Variation of the standard farm map with a single source of water behind the farmhouse. The perimeter has been expanded with the removal of the bottom left and middle right protrusions.

[b]Optional LovelyNewt version details[/b]

The optional division markings version includes a series of rock markers that divide the farm into (mostly) equal parts following my personal farm layout as[url=https://stardew.info/planner/lovely-newt-13/#] illustrated here[/url]. If you notice the end denominator is Lovely Newt 13, if any of you are curious, that is why I used that name in the game files.

As of version 2.0, the markings were changed to white pebble roads placed there presumably by Abigail so that she wouldn't keep tripping over everything and didn't keep getting lost when exploring the old overgrown fields.

[spoiler]
For those that don't know, this is a newt (yes I had to look it up myself).
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newt]https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newt[/url]
And this is a lovely newt (because cuteness is why).
[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/intermediary/f/8708b282-11b3-4bfc-ba55-a69569fa7d4f/d3l492a-3ea099e5-cd4e-4bb6-af63-5bd5143f4c60.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.deviantart.com/ursulav/art/Newt-Doodle-216868834]https://www.deviantart.com/ursulav/art/Newt-Doodle-216868834[/url]﻿
[/spoiler]

[b][center][size=6]Requirements[/size][/center][/b][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley v. 1.3.36+[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI v. 2.11.2+[/url]﻿﻿ (for CP and MTN versions)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher v.1.9+[/url]﻿﻿ (for CP version only)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2256]More Than Necessary v.1.2.5+[/url] (for MTN version only)﻿[/size]
[/list]

[size=6][center][b]Installation
[/b][/center][/size][center][color=#ffff00][b][u][size=3]
Attention:[/size][/u][/b] Vortex and other Mod Manager users.
I have no idea how to use any of the currently available managers correctly and have not tested this mod through these options. I did leave the download with manager button available in the downloads section for your possible convenience, but I cannot and will not provide any support for my mod when installed in this manner. Please follow the standard SMAPI mod install pattern as detailed below.[/color][/center]

[color=#00ff00][b]For Content Patcher Users:[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI (version 2.11.2+)[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher (version 1.9+)[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod (CP version) and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*][i][color=#00ffff]Optional:[/color][/i] Open the [code]config.json[/code] file using a text editor (I use [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url]﻿, but plain old Notepad works too) and answer the question with a simple [code]true or false[/code] (defaults to false). For details on what it means, please look above in the Information section of this document.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[color=#00ff00][b]For MTN Users:[/b] [/color](ID#44)
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2256]MTN[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod (MTN version) and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]By default, the game will load the "standard" version of my mod. If you would prefer to use the LovelyNewt version you will have to switch around both the .tbin and .xnb files. Neither needs to be renamed but I recommend placing the default files in an appropriately named folder instead of the LovelyNewt folder, or rename said folder. 
[/list][color=#ffff00][i][center][b]WARNING:[/b] This version has not been thoroughly tested and I can offer very little support for it. Use it at your own risk.[/center][/i][/color]

[b][color=#00ff00]For those that still prefer to use an XNB version (for whatever the reason):[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]I have provided the appropriate files in a separate download for both versions. Simply backup and replace the vanilla file [code]farm.xnb[/code] within [code]*\StardewValley\Content\Maps[/code] folder.
[/list][size=6][b][center]
Compatibility[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#ffff00]This mod is NOT compatible with any other mod that replaces the Farm.xnb file.[/color]
[*]This mod has yet to be tested in[color=#ff00ff] [/color][color=#00ffff]multiplayer mode[/color][color=#ff7700],[/color] but there should be no issues that I'm aware of. Please let me know if you find anything as I do not use this mode, and honestly, I'm unsure as to how it works.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2271]Extended Minecart[/url]﻿ ([color=#00ff00][b]compatible[/b][/color])
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2777](CP) Pethouse Re-skin to match Yellog's Buildings[/url]﻿ ([color=#ff0000][b]incompatible[/b][/color], [color=#00ff00]use the alternate version in downloads v1.0 only;[/color][color=#ffff00] for v2.0 the Pethouse mod should be updated to use the [code]EditMap[/code] CP function instead of loading the entire map, I may provide this update at a later time[/color])
[/list]
[size=6][b][center]
Known Issues[/center][/b][/size]
As of version 2.0.0 and June 28, 2019, these are the known issues, bugs, or incompatibilities with other mods [color=#ffff00]that do not involve the Farm.xnb file[/color]. If you find anymore, [i][b]please report them using the NexusMods integrated bug reporting section[/b][/i] within the main mod page.

[list]
[*]When fishing on the right side of the pond, you must have a yellow or better gauge. If you attempt to fish while the gauge is in red, the attempt will fail, this is a limitation of the game and cannot be fixed at this time. (in SDV v1.3.36 I have yet to test out for this bug)
[*][s]In the MTN version of the mod, grandpa's shrine will not display the note correctly. Instead of being placed on the shrine itself, it "blew away" further down the map. However, the interaction point for the shrine remains the same and works as intended. This is a current limitation with the current version of MTN and cannot be resolved (to my knowledge) at this time.[/s] [color=#ff00ff][b]Fixed with MTN 2.0.0-alpha8.[/b][/color]
[*][s]As "reported" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53973002]Celesty0[/url] in the comments section. The marking stones for the Lovely Newt version of the map cannot be tilled or built over at this time. The temporary solution (which I should have placed here a long time ago now) is to use the mods configuration file and select the normal version instead of the Lovely Newt version either from the beginning or when you have used some other way to mark where the roads should go. I will try to finally fix this sooner rather than later.[/s][b][color=#ff00ff] Fixed with mod version 2.0.0, I also removed the config.json file from the archive so that it will always generate a new one when first installing this mod.[/color][/b]
[/list]
